name: veracity-actions
description: Explicit action-skill stubs extracted from the Veracity operating contract. Product-surface review only; workflows and persistence are not implemented.

interface.shortDescription: Review explicit action skills before implementation.
interface.longDescription: A reviewable skeleton of sixteen explicitly invoked skills for attention, continuity, evidence, decisions, artifacts, and diagnostics. Selecting a stub shows its intended surface. This version performs no persistence or operational workflow and installs no hooks or MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Show the proposed Veracity Actions surface.
